scope: A separate Node/tsx process reads a real RUNNING VideoEncodeJob from disposable PostgreSQL 17.11 and invokes the production Self-HLS finalizer.

database.container: tmpfs, loopback-only port 55445; removed after the test
database.fixture_cleanup: Test afterAll verified zero K20 user fixtures before removing the disposable database.

test.command: DATABASE_URL=<disposable PostgreSQL 17> DATABASE_URL_UNPOOLED=<same> npx vitest run --config vitest.postgres.config.ts tests/postgres/k20-auto-publish-channel.pg.test.ts
test.new_case: The child process reads a real job row, invokes createSelfHlsFinalizer, and auto-publishes a non-main creator's video as UNLISTED. Parent process confirms creatorId, active route, asset.videoId, expected attempt object key, and publishAfterAssetReadyCompletedAt.
test.existing_cases: PUBLIC/UNLISTED on non-main channel, suspended/deleted channel refusals, mismatched job channel, main channel, and stale attempt fencing.

limits: This child process runs the actual database-backed finalizer, not the complete encoder worker loop.
Encoder output, poster path, and HLS objects are synthetic; no real R2/S3 was used.
No deployed process, production service, or external system was used.
remaining: K20 remains partial pending independent review and non-production acceptance with the full encoder worker and real R2/HLS.
